tool_args.rationale: The paid rows identify the smooth baseline, but the highest u_now and highest s_grad occur in different rows. A joint-activation sink could therefore be invisible in all six observations. The remaining trajectory batch offers a chance to test where the mechanisms diverge before committing to a forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Confirm the smooth saturation model with sink attenuation and a square-root correction
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all six rows to rounding precision, but no row tests the upper end of u_now and s_grad together. The fit does not identify whether an additional sink activates there.
The acquired point has low s_grad and already agrees with the smooth baseline; repeating it would not test joint activation.
